'''Thoax Osaax''', along with his brother [[Farge Osaax]], was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] around [[3700 BBY/Legends|3700 BBY]]. In competition with [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]], he and Farge extended parts of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. However, her tenacity forced the Osaax to hire [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Banu Hydia]] to eliminate her, which did not go as planned. The Neimoidians crippled Kallea's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and it crash-landed on [[Nuvar]], where she spent six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in captivity.<ref name="EA" />

Twenty two hundred years later, the Osaaxs and Kallea's explorations were immortalized in ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]''.<ref name="EA" />
